name: Dual-Grid Non-Manifold Contouring
definition: A method to extract non-manifold meshes from segmented volumes with multiple materials by using a dual grid composed of voxels rather than cells, avoiding large lookup tables required for multi-material cases.
summary: Dual-Grid Non-Manifold Contouring extracts non-manifold meshes from segmented volumes by generating quadrilateral faces at voxel boundaries and resolving topological ambiguities via priority-based vertex splitting, avoiding large lookup tables.
